Method of Attack: Fetches a malicious script that searches for local passwords and exfiltrates them via a Discord webhook
Steals users' credentials as part of its setup.py installation script
Collects and sends installers' credentials to a predefined discord webhook
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic 'art', a popular ASCII Art Library for Python
Indicators of Compromise: Similar description to 'art' without release details
Uploads stolen data to a publicly exposed endpoint
